strings.Keep a report of every game session in B: Keep a report of every game session in BepInEx/DamageInsight/CrashReports (the newest 20): errors, what happened before them, and whose code they were in (the game's, SkulInsight's or another mod's). Says so on screen when the game seems stuck or the last session ended unexpectedly. Send the report with a bug report.
strings.Keep every run in the Codex: how it ende: Keep every run in the Codex: how it ended, the end screen's numbers, your build, the damage of each piece of gear, the maps and a timeline of skulls, items and inscriptions. Each save slot keeps its own.
strings.How many of your newest runs keep all th: How many of your newest runs keep all their details (timeline, damage, picture). Older runs keep only their summary, unless you starred them.
strings.At every start, look on Thunderstore for: At every start, look on Thunderstore for a newer SkulInsight QoL and install it; it runs from the next start. In an r2modman profile its mod list gets the new version too. The old version is kept in BepInEx/DamageInsight/Mods/Backup.
strings.The mod's buttons play the game's menu s: The mod's buttons play the game's menu sounds when the mouse moves onto them or clicks them.
strings.Record how every hit's number came about: Record how every hit's number came about (stats, items, inscriptions, dark abilities, crits, debuffs); hover a log line to see it.
strings.Also write every hit (with its calculati: Also write every hit (with its calculation) to BepInEx/DamageInsight/CombatLogs, one file per game session (the newest 30 are kept).
Show a few log lines above the minimap. Can also be switched in the combat log window.
How many lines the mini log shows.
strings.Hide the mini log when no new damage cam: Hide the mini log when no new damage came in for this long.
strings.Show a tiny pie chart at the right of th: Show a tiny pie chart at the right of the mini log.
strings.Distance between the minimap and the min: Distance between the minimap and the mini log (in pixels at 1920x1080).
strings.Show the remaining seconds on the skill,: Show the remaining seconds on the skill, swap, quintessence, item and ability icons (83s, 2m+, 10m). Cooldown speed bonuses are included.
How strongly the seconds are drawn.
strings.A Mods button in the pause menu: Thunder: A Mods button in the pause menu: Thunderstore's Skul mods and yours side by side, with search, details and their Thunderstore pages. It only goes online (Thunderstore) when you open it.
strings.A Mods button in the pause menu: your Be: A Mods button in the pause menu: your BepInEx mods (turn on / off, remove) and Thunderstore's Skul mods to install or update. It only goes online (Thunderstore) when you open it; changes need a restart of the game.
strings.How the healing orbs enemies drop look:: How the healing orbs enemies drop look: the game's purple orb, the game's Portable Potion (a bit bigger, with a green glow) or a big green plus. The run history counts the ones you leave behind while hurt.
strings.When a map is cleared while you are hurt: When a map is cleared while you are hurt and healing orbs are left on it, a short text above you says so (once per map).
strings.Make the effects of your skills, items a: Make the effects of your skills, items and summons fainter, so enemy attacks stay easy to see with a strong build. Enemy attacks and their warnings are never faded.
How faint your effects get at most.
strings.Full in chapter 1, getting fainter chapt: Full in chapter 1, getting fainter chapter by chapter, the lowest opacity from chapter 5 on (the Dark Mirror's chapters the same).
strings.When many of your effects are on screen: When many of your effects are on screen at once, they fade in any chapter (from 8 at once; the lowest opacity at 40). With both off, your effects always have the lowest opacity.
strings.Your projectiles and your summons' fade: Your projectiles and your summons' fade with your effects.
strings.Record your progress for the Codex (enem: Record your progress for the Codex (enemies met and killed, gear found) and capture enemy pictures.
strings.The key that opens and closes the Codex: The key that opens and closes the Codex book.
strings.Under a boss move in the Codex: when the: Under a boss move in the Codex: when the boss uses it (HP range, distance, cooldown...), read from its AI. Shown once you have beaten the boss.
strings.Film each boss attack once (a small pict: Film each boss attack once (a small picture 10 times a second, effects included) to show it in the Codex.
strings.Add the projectile an enemy fires (arrow: Add the projectile an enemy fires (arrow, bolt, ...) to its pictures in the Codex, the first time it fires one.
strings.Save boss films as compact pictures (abo: Save boss films as compact pictures (about a quarter of the size, nearly the same look). Off: lossless pictures, about 1 GB more once every boss is filmed.
strings.During a run, the Codex opens on the You: During a run, the Codex opens on the You page (your skulls, items, inscriptions and stats). Off: it opens on the page you read last.
strings.How loud the little chime of the achieve: How loud the little chime of the achievement notice is (0%: no sound). The game's master and effects volume apply too.
strings.When this save slot earns an achievement: When this save slot earns an achievement, a small box with it slides down from the top of the screen for a few seconds. Each slot earns its achievements on its own, also the ones your Steam account has.
strings.Achievements that give the story away st: Achievements that give the story away stay veiled in the Codex (You, Achievements) until you earn them, meet what they are about, or hold the mouse button on them for 4 seconds.
strings.Left / right: choose a slot. Each slot i: Left / right: choose a slot. Each slot is a whole game of its own: story, rescued NPCs, the Witch, Dark Mirror, your run and its own Codex.
How many save slots there are (3 to 5).
strings.Boss films show only the boss: damage nu: Boss films show only the boss: damage numbers, the effects of your skills and items, your summons and status effects on the boss (poison, burn, freeze, ...) are left out.
strings.Puts the combat log window back to its d: Puts the combat log window back to its default place and size (you can drag it and pull its corners; it remembers where you left it).
strings.Opens the folder with the crash reports: Opens the folder with the crash reports (one file per game session, named by its start time). Add the newest one to your bug report.
strings.Switches to the selected slot. Your curr: Switches to the selected slot. Your current game stays in its own slot (a run too, at the room you entered last) and the game goes back to the title screen. An empty slot starts a new game.
strings.Copies the game you are playing, with it: Copies the game you are playing, with its Codex, into the selected slot. What the slot held is replaced.
strings.Empties the selected slot: its game and: Empties the selected slot: its game and its Codex are deleted. The slot you are playing can't be cleared.
strings.Deletes everything the Codex has gathere: Deletes everything the Codex has gathered (progress, films, pictures) the next time the game starts, so you can fill it again from the start. The move notes stay. Select it again before restarting to keep everything.
strings.Puts every setting on this page back to: Puts every setting on this page back to its default. Your Codex progress stays as it is.
Takes effect in the Codex at once.
strings.Select it and press the new key (Esc kee: Select it and press the new key (Esc keeps the old one).
strings.The icon next to {0} damage numbers. \"T: The icon next to {0} damage numbers. "Text tag" shows a short word instead (ATK, SKILL, ITEM...). Other icons (skill:Name, item:Name...) can be typed into the config file.
strings.Play slot {0}? Your current game stays i: Play slot {0}? Your current game stays in slot {1}. The game goes back to the title screen.
strings.Start a new game in slot {0}? Your curre: Start a new game in slot {0}? Your current game stays in slot {1}. The game goes back to the title screen.
strings.Replace slot {0} with a copy of your gam: Replace slot {0} with a copy of your game (and its Codex)?
strings.Copy your game (and its Codex) into slot: Copy your game (and its Codex) into slot {0}?
strings.Clear slot {0}? Its game and its Codex a: Clear slot {0}? Its game and its Codex are deleted.
strings.Delete everything the Codex has gathered: Delete everything the Codex has gathered (progress, films, pictures) the next time the game starts?
strings.Reset all {0} settings to their defaults: Reset all {0} settings to their defaults?
strings.Every setting of the mod in one place. C: Every setting of the mod in one place. Changes apply at once and are saved right away (BepInEx/config/docrun.skulinsight_qol.cfg).

strings.Rewards: every achievement of your save: Rewards: every achievement of your save slot gives a small lasting bonus that fits it, like more damage to a boss you beat (more without getting hit), attack, speed or gold (Codex, You, Rewards).
strings.Coins: break a legendary item or skull,: Coins: break a legendary item or skull, or beat an adventurer a few times, and its coin summons that gear in a later run. A run ended with Omen items gives Omen coins.
strings.Kill quests: every normal enemy has an e: Kill quests: every normal enemy has an endless quest that pays dark quartz and gold.
strings.Inscription activations: complete an ins: Inscription activations: complete an inscription in a run, and in a later run one you have counts one more, like the Dark Mirror's banners.
strings.Rewards can be turned off at the top of: Rewards can be turned off at the top of the settings page; daily runs never use them.
strings.Daily runs: every day Normal, the Dark M: Daily runs: every day Normal, the Dark Mirror at a random level and Dark Mirror 10, each with and without the DLC and each with its own board. Everyone gets the same gifts in the castle and the same blessing.
strings.Also new since 0.14: achievements per sa: Also new since 0.14: achievements per save slot with a small notice, Clear view, the Mods browser, healing orbs that are easier to see, macOS.
strings.Everything else: the Changelog button in: Everything else: the Changelog button in your mod manager.
